description: Tells you the state of the connection: the connector version, the site this chat is signed in to, and whether that connection is open right now. It needs no input and changes nothing. Take it first when something does not answer, for example when a host says "It says I am not connected, but I just approved it." If one sign-in carries several sites, it lists them all and says which one is meant now. It never returns site data. Words hosts use: connector status, connected, not connected, sign-in

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_get_connector_status
title: Read the connector status
